item.text: Galaxy’s ORF scan identified a dominant forward ORF with header coordinates `[283 - 1335]`; the other reported ORFs are much shorter. I’m now checking EMBOSS’s endpoint/stop-codon convention and measuring the translated sequence directly so the requested 0-based start and protein length are unambiguous.

item.text: The terminal Galaxy length output reports 351 residues for the isolated dominant ORF. I’m performing one final interval check on the nucleotide form to confirm whether EMBOSS’s bracketed coordinates are inclusive 1-based, which determines the exact zero-based start conversion.
